name: Easier Parry and Dodge
author: Kintaro
description: Wider perfect deflect and perfect dodge windows (x1.5 by default, up to x3 or Always), with optional extras: no build-up or elemental damage on a guard, slow motion before blue, red or black attacks, auto guard. A PBZModLoader mod; settings in a text file in its folder, or on its Mods Menu page, live in game.
